mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where RSAFS shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points within a quarter signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3pp within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals increased economic activity and corporate output, which boosts investor confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% each within a quarter signals a robust demand environment, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS increase > 2% each in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 2% each within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 within a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% signals inflationary pressures, which erodes purchasing power and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where CPIAUCSL shows a sustained 3-month increase by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% each within a quarter signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO increase > 1% each in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase by more than 1% each within a quarter.
